title: Great Book Human Map / Nexus of Being — Recovered Mathematics Audit
status: old-document archaeology + mathematical repair; not an empirical consciousness theory
source_note: Recovered from The Great Book Of Potato2.odt, especially parsed pages 504-509 and 533-540. The source mixed established mathematics, project-created formulas, phenomenology and unsupported numerical neuroscience claims.
epistemic_rule: Preserve the historical equations, but never promote mixed-unit or unsupported formulas into physical law. Each recovered form is typed as established comparator, project schematic, or quarantined formula.

recovered_equations.name: Thalamic oscillation equation
recovered_equations.audit: As written, coefficients and inputs mix concentrations, flow/frequency and membrane voltage without a dimensional model. It is not a valid biophysical membrane equation.
recovered_equations.repair: If retained, replace with a dimensionally explicit neural-mass or conductance model, e.g. C_m dV/dt = -Σ g_k(V-E_k)+I_ext, and treat neuromodulators as parameters controlling conductances or gains rather than quantities added directly to voltage.

recovered_equations.name: Claustrum synchrony
recovered_equations.historical_form: S_claustrum(t)=Σ_i w_i sin(2π f_gamma t) exp(-k D_state) cos(phi_cortex)
recovered_equations.audit: Mathematically evaluable only if D_state, k, phases and weights are dimensionless/normalized; historical interpretation as an enlightenment predictor was unsupported.
recovered_equations.repair: Use phase-locking value, coherence, weighted phase synchrony or a Kuramoto order parameter R(t)=|N^-1 Σ_j exp(i theta_j)| as the measurable synchronization variable.

recovered_equations.name: CSF oscillator
recovered_equations.audit: A phenomenological oscillator, not a derived glymphatic equation. Exponential attenuation requires k[amyloid] dimensionless and a defined concentration variable.
recovered_equations.repair: Treat it as a signal-processing toy model only, or fit measured CSF waveform components from MRI/physiology rather than assigning consciousness meaning.

recovered_equations.name: Predictive-coding score
recovered_equations.audit: This is not Bayes' theorem; oscillatory phase factors were appended without a probabilistic derivation.
recovered_equations.repair: Use p(h|y) ∝ p(y|h)p(h) for Bayesian inference, or an explicitly specified generative model whose neural phases modulate likelihood precision.

recovered_equations.name: Variational free-energy expression
recovered_equations.origin_class: established-math-neighbor reconstructed from malformed source notation
recovered_equations.audit: The source's signs/terms were garbled. The rigorous identity is F[q]=E_q[log q(s)-log p(y,s)] = KL(q(s)||p(s|y)) - log p(y).
recovered_equations.repair: Keep this as an external variational-inference comparator, not as proof of the Human Map.

recovered_equations.name: Cultural-prior weighting
recovered_equations.audit: A useful schematic for context weighting if all terms are defined; not a validated cultural-neuroscience law.
recovered_equations.repair: Normalize weights and use hierarchical Bayesian models or mixed-effects models when actual cross-cultural data exist.

recovered_equations.name: Transcendent / emotional cascade
recovered_equations.historical_form: T_cascade(t)=Σ_i w_i sin(2πf_i t) exp(R_i D_state) cos(phi_i) cos(theta_i)
recovered_equations.audit: Historically intended to combine gamma, affect, fractal state and oxytocin. The source confused phase variables with biochemical concentrations.
recovered_equations.repair: Split neural oscillatory phases from biochemical covariates; estimate them in a state-space or generalized linear model rather than multiplying incomparable units.

recovered_equations.name: Self-actualization score
recovered_equations.audit: Invalid as a physical equation because biochemical concentration, spectral power and psychological score are added directly.
recovered_equations.repair: If used as a research index, z-score each measured feature within a declared population, pre-register weights, and call the result an exploratory composite score rather than 'self-actualization' itself.

recovered_equations.name: Collective-unity oscillator
recovered_equations.historical_form: U_collective=Σ_i w_i cos(phi_vagus,i) sin(2π f_theta,i t) exp(k D_ritual,i)
recovered_equations.audit: No validated physiological interpretation as written.
recovered_equations.repair: For group experiments use hyperscanning measures such as inter-brain phase-locking/coherence plus behavioral coordination, with permutation/null controls for common sensory drive.

recovered_equations.name: EEG coherence aggregate
recovered_equations.audit: Covariance depends on scale and reference; the historical fractal-state modifier was unsupported.
recovered_equations.repair: Prefer normalized coherence, imaginary coherence, phase-locking statistics or graph measures with artifact/source-leakage controls.

recovered_equations.name: Network score
recovered_equations.audit: Degree, betweenness and clustering are legitimate graph quantities, but their historical numerical values and direct mapping to transcendence were unsupported.
recovered_equations.repair: Keep the measures separately or combine only after normalization and validation.

recovered_equations.name: Box-counting fractal dimension
recovered_equations.audit: Legitimate definition. The old assignments D=4.5 'Enlightenment' and D=3.0 'NPD' are quarantined and must not be repeated as established findings.

recovered_equations.name: Neural avalanche power law
recovered_equations.audit: A legitimate criticality-style distribution family. Evidence for a power law requires model comparison, finite-size analysis and alternatives, not visual log-log straightness.

recovered_equations.name: Consciousness Spiral
recovered_equations.audit: Mathematically valid logarithmic spiral with exact quarter-turn scaling r(theta+pi/2)=phi r(theta). Physical/neural interpretation remains project-specific.

recovered_equations.name: Human Map composite
recovered_equations.audit: Historically important but underdefined. It is a function signature, not yet a model.
recovered_equations.repair: Define a typed feature vector first; do not combine physical, network, phenomenological and speculative quantum terms without normalization, measurement protocols and a trained/validated mapping.

consciousness_research_upgrade.principle: Replace fixed mystical numbers with state estimation and falsifiable comparisons.
candidate_observables: behavioral report reliability and task performance
autonomic variables such as HRV when relevant
fMRI network connectivity with preregistered preprocessing
consciousness_research_upgrade.exploratory_state_vector: q_conscious=(spectral_shape, complexity, metastability, integration, segregation, connectivity, report, behavior, physiology)
consciousness_research_upgrade.enlightenment_rule: Do not encode 'enlightenment' as a biological constant. Operationalize a specific state or trait (e.g. sustained nondual report, attentional stability, compassion behavior, meditation expertise) and compare against controls.
consciousness_research_upgrade.exploratory_index: E*=w^T z(q_conscious) may be used only as a preregistered dimensionless research score with held-out validation; it is not enlightenment itself.
